description: The activities of a window (docs/spec/activity.md). Each case of tabs gives a tab, its plugin and its statuses that declare activity, each as {name, value} with the value that the surface of the tab reports (absent when the surface has not registered the status), and returns {activity, error}: the activity of the tab, or null, and the text of the error that a value that is neither an activity nor null shows (docs/spec/activity.md#activity-of-a-tab), or null. Each case of windows gives the projects of a window, each {id, spaces} with the layouts of its spaces in the stored form (docs/spec/groups.md#storage), and the activity of each tab that has one, and returns the value of core.activity: the activities of the projects, their spaces, cards and group cards and of the tabs, each listed only with an activity.

tabs.name: a value that is an activity gives that activity
a null value gives no activity
a status that the surface has not registered gives no activity
a tab without statuses that declare activity has no activity
the highest activity of the statuses of a tab is its activity
failed stands above running and idle
a string that is no activity gives none and is an error that names the plugin, the status and the value

returns.error: probe exposes probe.s on tab t1: activity value "busy" is not one of attention, failed, running, idle

tabs.name: a value that is not a string is an error

returns.error: probe exposes probe.s on tab t1: activity value {"busy":true} is not one of attention, failed, running, idle

tabs.name: a status with a wrong value leaves the activities of the other statuses, and the first wrong status in the order of the statuses is the error

returns.error: probe exposes probe.b on tab t1: activity value "Running" is not one of attention, failed, running, idle

windows.name: a window in which no tab has an activity reports nothing
a card takes the highest activity of its tabs, and the space and the project take it from the card
a group card takes the highest activity of its members, and an enclosing group card the highest activity of the group cards inside it
a group card whose members have no activity has none
a project takes the highest activity of its spaces, and a space without an activity is not listed
each project of a window has its own activity
a seat card and a window sidebar hold no tabs, and the activity of a tab outside the layouts is not listed
